OUR MISSION: We like to inspire our customers to live a more minimalist life, prioritizing conscient consumption decision making. One Bars Over Bottles shampoo is equivalent to two average sized (6.7oz) shampoo bottles, and one conditioner bar to three plastic bottles. Join our #plasticfreebathroom mission!

The packaging industry is responsible for the world's largest plastic production, overloading our environment with single use plastic. Why carry bottled water along the entire supply chain and into our homes, when we already have water in our bathrooms?

For this reason, we transform liquid personal hygiene and beauty products into bars containing only the ingredients that you really need. You already have water at home.

LEADING PLASTIC-FREE BRAND: We are proud to be the leading 100% waterless, plastic free, zero waste & clean beauty company in Brazil, eliminating the use of over 100,000 plastic bottles every month. listing.title: ZHORN Color Express Transparent Film with Smart Adhesive for Hair Coloring, Highlights, Balayage & More
bullets: WORK FASTER & MORE EFFICIENTLY - With countless advantages over traditional aluminum foil, the Easy Color is revolutionizing the way hair stylists perform highlights, lowlights, balayage, and other hair coloring treatments all over the world! This ENVIRONMENTALLY FRIENDLY product is 100% recyclable after use and features packaging made out of recycled materials! Recommended for professional use

TRANSPARENT& ADHESIVE – Check the hair color during processing time without having to open up foils! Hair firmly grips onto the adhesive allowing you to get closer to the roots and easily isolate small amounts of hair while providing a better working surface. Water-soluble adhesive dissolves once product is applied giving you the ability to massage the product throughout the hair to ensure full saturation and makes it easily removable when it is time.

NO CUTTING OR CLIPS – Each roll has 300 pre-perforated sheets and sits comfortably on your arm while you work; giving you whatever length you need by simply pulling and tearing! The sheets will firmly stay in place once applied without the need for clips or fasteners ensuring that no product spills or spreads to unwanted areas. Being lighter and less bulky than aluminum, even your clients will enjoy the added comfort and mobility!

SAVE UP TO 35% ON BLEACH & COLOR – Aluminum foil naturally oxidizes and dries out products; requiring you to use excess amounts and often have to add more throughout the process. The Easy Color does not oxidize product or let it dry up because its water-soluble adhesive helps keep the hair moisturized and also because exposure to air is greatly reduced. This allows you to achieve the same results using much less product which saves you money!

HEALTHIER FOR HAIR – Foil gets very hot and dries out the product and hair inside, exposing dry hair to high temperatures for extended periods which causes severe damage. The Easy Color gets sealed along the sides creating a THERMIC POUCH with much better conditions for the hair coloring process which keeps the hair saturated the entire time with the additional help of the water-soluble adhesive which adds moisture to the hair when it dissolves.
description: The #1 alternative to using salon foil! Much healthier, faster, and efficient!

bullets: Natural and gentle enough for facial skin.
Leaves skin beautifully.
Remove unwanted hair.
description: What is it? Persian Cold Wax is a natural hair removal product. It is known as Cold Wax and is a sugar based formula. This is a waxing kit, which means it comes with: 60ml of cold wax, 20 fabric strips and 2 spatulas. These fabric strips are washable & reusable.  Who is it for? This is a kit for those wanting to fine to medium hair (not coarse?). Previously shaved hair should have at least 2 weeks of growth. If you have coarse hair, get in touch via Amazon, we’ll recommend another product for you.  How do I use it? Lukewarm wax may be a better description than Cold wax. The wax should be a honey consistency, as a thin layer is required. NOTE: A thin layer of wax is very important to get the best results. Place jar in microwave 20 seconds. Apply a thin layer of wax, press on strip, zip off quickly and parallel to your skin and opposite the direction of hair growth. The waxing kit comes with instructions, for best results please read these carefully. Please do not be shy, our contact details are on the packaging, get in touch if you are having any issues. Technique can make all the difference.  How do I clean it? Sugar-based waxes are easy to clean and water-soluble. Simply use a washcloth and water!  More info on Persian Cold Wax: This washable hair removal wax can be used for facial waxing, leg waxing & body waxing. In the tradition of Eastern elegance & beauty in its purest form, Persian Cold Wax has remained unchanged since 1970. This proven hair remover works beautifully so, unlike any other. Persian wax is a luxurious cold wax also known as sugar wax. Made on the West Coast of Canada, it is Canada's number 1 cold wax. Persian wax contains all natural ingredients, the main ingredients are sugar, citric acid and water. This authentic sugar based formula has been trusted by women for centuries. Ideal for sensitive skin, this hair removal wax will lift hair cleanly from the root for salon-smooth skin. Persian wax is long lasting hair removal. Hair removal by waxing lasts for weeks longer than shaving. Waxing removes hair from the root, discouraging re-growth over time. Detailed photo instructions come along with the waxing kit, be sure to read first for the best hair removal results. This kit contains everything you need for at-home body waxing.

listing.title: Pipette Overnight Brightening Exfoliating Mask - Face Exfoliator With Moisturizing Squalane & Hyaluronic Acid, Vegan (2 fl oz)
bullets: WORKS WHILE YOU SLEEP - This This gentle yet effective brightening mask works while you sleep to combat dullness, address discoloration, and boost skin’s natural exfoliation process.

KEY INGREDIENTS - It’s made with our proprietary hydrating squalane and vegan lactic acid, a gentle alpha hydroxy acid that helps to smooth skin without stripping moisture. Use this overnight mask to wake up to soft, moisturized skin and a luminous, "I-just-got-eight-hours" glow.
VISBILE RESULTS - Helps skin to look brighter, more hydrated, softer and smoother. It also helps pores look more refined and improves overall look of discoloration.

HOW TO USE - Apply an even layer of this brightening mask to clean, dry skin before bed, allowing mask to absorb completely. Leave on overnight and rinse off in the morning; for quicker results and gentler exfoliation, rinse off after 3–10 minutes. Use 2–3 times weekly.

SAFE & EFFECTIVE - This mask is dermatologist tested, hypoallergenic and safe for sensitive skin. *Sunburn Alert: Overnight Brightening Mask contains an alpha hydroxy acid (AHA) that may increase your skin’s sensitivity to the sun and particularly the possibility of sunburn. Use sunscreen, wear protective clothing, and limit sun exposure while using this product and for a week afterward. Use only as directed above. Avoid contact with eyes. For external use only.

bullets: INVIGORATING FRAGRANCE – Revitalize and Recharge yourself with the refreshing mint fragrance. They will leave you feeling refreshed and new as you step out of the shower

COMPLETELY HANDMADE - Falls River Soap is a small family business based in Ohio. We never outsource our work, and our soaps are carefully handmade in small batches to ensure the highest quality possible.

description: ** Member Handcrafted Soap & Cosmetics Guild Eucalyptus Spearmint, Refreshing Mint Soap for Sensitive Skin. This soap can charge you up and take away tiredness with the fresh refreshing mint essential oils This exotic moisturizing eucalyptus soap is made with Spearmint oil extracts. The soap also contains Shea Butter and natural Glycerin extracts. The Eucalyptus oil is obtained from the leaves of the Eucalyptus species native to Australia while the spearmint extracts are sourced from the Spearmint plant which is mostly found in the Middle East and parts of Asia. Eucalyptus oil has had long-standing medicinal applications in the past. It has antioxidants and anti-inflammation properties which can help heal sensitive or infected skin and scalp. Eucalyptus oil is also renowned for its ability to soothe and calm the body and is often marketed for its ability to relieve stress. It also has a distinctive sweet smell which adds a great flavor to the soap bar. The spearmint oil also has a sweet scent and its mint flavor helps to cool the skin. The Eucalyptus Spearmint Soap Bar is great for long relaxing baths especially after a long hard day. Step out of the shower feeling relaxed and refreshed. We use organic and high quality natural essential oils, herbs and botanical sourced from all over the world to create homemade soaps the old-fashioned way, through the cold-process method of soap-making. It’s not your skin’s fault--it’s your soap! Store-bought soap contains harsh chemicals that irritate your skin, often resulting in conditions like eczema, acne, and psoriasis. Switch to Falls Rivers Soap and experience the difference in using all-natural soaps created by hand using cold process soapmaking. It is a perfect gift giving soap, stocking stuffer during holidays.
